external_reference_additions.name: CROSS visual multi-session mapping, localization and relocalization benchmark
external_reference_additions.claim_limit: Separates T1 mapping ATE/completeness, T2 stored-map localization recall/map-frame ATE, and T3 cross-session relocalization success. Uses KITTI, OpenLORIS-Scene, ROVER and SimChange v3. Some configurations use dataset/external or ground-truth-derived odometry; reproduce only with matching sensor/odometry privileges and failure denominator. Does not measure PNT protection-level integrity.

external_reference_additions.name: IMO Resolution MSC.401(95): Performance standards for multi-system shipborne radionavigation receivers
external_reference_additions.claim_limit: Maritime profile reference requiring integrity monitoring for each PVT source, multi-source autonomous integrity monitoring, phase-specific performance assessment and alerting when performance cannot be determined. It defines receiver performance requirements, not a universal navigation algorithm or this benchmark's general conformance.

internal_method_references.reuse_rule: Reuse the reviewed Clopper-Pearson / monotone quantile interval implementation; do not implement a second binomial confidence engine.
internal_method_references.navigation_adaptation: Define independent units using the navigation dataset hierarchy (route/site/recording session, device/campaign, scenario generator, oracle provenance). Repeated frames/windows within a continuous trajectory do not increase n. Report episode-cluster exceedance and per-epoch exposure separately.

protocol_extensions: For multi-session localization, reproduce the fixed CROSS T1/T2/T3 protocol only with identical sensor inputs, odometry privileges, map sessions, query sessions, tuning rules and failure accounting.
For maritime sector comparisons, map the evaluation to a named MSC.401(95) profile and the actual navigation phase; do not infer broad certification from this synthetic corpus.
For integrity-risk confidence intervals, use SIM-REL-054's exact interval method only after the navigation episode/cluster hierarchy and independence assumptions are preregistered and audited.
note: These additions are comparator/standard references and protocol guidance. No external data, code, paper result or regulatory conformance has been reproduced.
